newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China's Shenbao sees 10-fold rise in profits.
newsitem.headline: China's Shenbao sees 10-fold rise in profits.

text.p: Beverage producer Shenzhen Shenbao Industrial Co Ltd said on Wednesday it estimated a 10-fold rise in its 1996 net profit from 3.62 million yuan ($436,144) in 1995.
The solid rise resulted from the sale of production facilities, investment returns and expansion of its sales network, said company spokesman Xu Yiqiao.
"The facilities sold to our 40 percent-owned venture with PepsiCo Inc generated 22 million yuan, which is the main factor in Shenbao's 1996 profit," Xu said.

Pepsi holds a 60 percent stake in the US$28-million-venture, which was set up in Shenzhen in February 1996. The venture generated net profit of about 30 million yuan in 1996, with Shenbao sharing about 12 million yuan, the spokesman said.
Shenbao also had good earnings from its investment in A shares last year, he said but did not give specific figures.
A 22 percent jump in sales also helped profits, Xu said, adding that Shenbao was expanding its domestic sales network.
